# IntoDimension Conversion Trait Implementation Plan

> **For agentic workers:** REQUIRED SUB-SKILL: Use superpowers:subagent-driven-development (recommended) or superpowers:executing-plans to implement this plan task-by-task. Steps use checkbox (`- [ ]`) syntax for tracking.

**Goal:** Define `IntoDimension` and implement the complete supported conversion matrix so tuple, array, slice, vector, and existing-dimension inputs normalize into Xenon's fixed or dynamic shape types.

**Architecture:** `src/dimension/into.rs` owns a single normalization trait. Static tuples and arrays preserve ranks `0..=6`; borrowed slices and owned `Vec<usize>` always produce `IxDyn`; identity conversion keeps existing `Dimension` implementations unchanged.

**Tech Stack:** Rust 1.85+, edition 2024, std

**Design Docs:** `design/02-dimension.md` §5.4 (IntoDimension trait), `design/02-dimension.md` §8.7 (type boundary notes), `design/02-dimension.md` §11 Decision 1 (no `Ix7+`)

**Prerequisites:** W3T1 must be complete.

### Task 2: Implement the conversion trait and all supported impls

**Files:**
- Modify: `src/dimension/into.rs`

- [ ] **Step 1: Write the complete `into.rs` implementation**

Replace `src/dimension/into.rs` with the following content:

```rust
use super::{Dimension, Ix0, Ix1, Ix2, Ix3, Ix4, Ix5, Ix6, IxDyn};

pub trait IntoDimension {
    type Dim: Dimension;

    fn into_dimension(self) -> Self::Dim;
}

impl<D: Dimension> IntoDimension for D {
    type Dim = D;

    #[inline]
    fn into_dimension(self) -> Self::Dim {
        self
    }
}

impl IntoDimension for () {
    type Dim = Ix0;

    fn into_dimension(self) -> Self::Dim {
        Ix0
    }
}

impl IntoDimension for (usize,) {
    type Dim = Ix1;

    fn into_dimension(self) -> Self::Dim {
        Ix1(self.0)
    }
}

impl IntoDimension for (usize, usize) {
    type Dim = Ix2;

    fn into_dimension(self) -> Self::Dim {
        Ix2(self.0, self.1)
    }
}

impl IntoDimension for (usize, usize, usize) {
    type Dim = Ix3;

    fn into_dimension(self) -> Self::Dim {
        Ix3(self.0, self.1, self.2)
    }
}

impl IntoDimension for (usize, usize, usize, usize) {
    type Dim = Ix4;

    fn into_dimension(self) -> Self::Dim {
        Ix4(self.0, self.1, self.2, self.3)
    }
}

impl IntoDimension for (usize, usize, usize, usize, usize) {
    type Dim = Ix5;

    fn into_dimension(self) -> Self::Dim {
        Ix5(self.0, self.1, self.2, self.3, self.4)
    }
}

impl IntoDimension for (usize, usize, usize, usize, usize, usize) {
    type Dim = Ix6;

    fn into_dimension(self) -> Self::Dim {
        Ix6(self.0, self.1, self.2, self.3, self.4, self.5)
    }
}

impl IntoDimension for &[usize] {
    type Dim = IxDyn;

    fn into_dimension(self) -> Self::Dim {
        IxDyn::from_slice(self)
    }
}

impl IntoDimension for Vec<usize> {
    type Dim = IxDyn;

    fn into_dimension(self) -> Self::Dim {
        IxDyn::from_vec(self)
    }
}

impl IntoDimension for [usize; 0] {
    type Dim = Ix0;

    fn into_dimension(self) -> Self::Dim {
        Ix0
    }
}

impl IntoDimension for [usize; 1] {
    type Dim = Ix1;

    fn into_dimension(self) -> Self::Dim {
        Ix1(self[0])
    }
}

impl IntoDimension for [usize; 2] {
    type Dim = Ix2;

    fn into_dimension(self) -> Self::Dim {
        Ix2(self[0], self[1])
    }
}

impl IntoDimension for [usize; 3] {
    type Dim = Ix3;

    fn into_dimension(self) -> Self::Dim {
        Ix3(self[0], self[1], self[2])
    }
}

impl IntoDimension for [usize; 4] {
    type Dim = Ix4;

    fn into_dimension(self) -> Self::Dim {
        Ix4(self[0], self[1], self[2], self[3])
    }
}

impl IntoDimension for [usize; 5] {
    type Dim = Ix5;

    fn into_dimension(self) -> Self::Dim {
        Ix5(self[0], self[1], self[2], self[3], self[4])
    }
}

impl IntoDimension for [usize; 6] {
    type Dim = Ix6;

    fn into_dimension(self) -> Self::Dim {
        Ix6(self[0], self[1], self[2], self[3], self[4], self[5])
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::IntoDimension;
    use crate::dimension::{Ix0, Ix1, Ix2, IxDyn};

    #[test]
    fn test_identity_into_dimension() {
        let dim = Ix2(2, 3).into_dimension();
        assert_eq!(dim, Ix2(2, 3));
    }

    #[test]
    fn test_tuple_into_dimension() {
        let dim = (2usize, 3usize).into_dimension();
        assert_eq!(dim, Ix2(2, 3));
    }

    #[test]
    fn test_array_rank_preserves_static_dim() {
        let dim = [4usize].into_dimension();
        let _: Ix1 = dim;
        assert_eq!(dim, Ix1(4));
    }

    #[test]
    fn test_slice_to_ixdyn() {
        let dim = (&[1usize, 2, 3][..]).into_dimension();
        let _: IxDyn = dim.clone();
        assert_eq!(dim.slice(), &[1, 2, 3]);
    }

    #[test]
    fn test_vec_to_ixdyn() {
        let dim = vec![7usize, 8].into_dimension();
        assert_eq!(dim.slice(), &[7, 8]);
    }

    #[test]
    fn test_zero_rank_array_to_ix0() {
        let dim = [].into_dimension();
        let _: Ix0 = dim;
    }
}
```
